title: Worth the price?
text: Worth the price?. Not as dark or rust in person. Pale and beige at best. Towels awful. (VERY thin and wrinkled.) Kept oven mitts only. Not good value but needed them.

product_metadata.title: Maison d' Hermine Potholders 100% Cotton 8"x8" Hotpads Heat Resistant with Loop Pot Holder for Gifts, Baking, Grilling, Home, Handling Hot Pans, Botanical Fresh - Spring/Summer
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: Maison d' Hermine package includes 1 Pot Holder sized 8"x8". Use as hot pads for hot dishes, coffee pot, hot pot, cast iron or cooking pot.
EASY CARE & MAINTENANCE: Machine wash warm with like colors, do not bleach, tumble dry low and warm iron if needed.
100% QUILTED COTTON - Unlike other pot holders, we only use the best quality cotton to ensure that only the finest pot holders produced end up on your hands

UNIQUE DESIGN: Each design is beautifully rendered in watercolor, with traditional motifs captured with a painter’s eye for light, hue, and lovely detail. The attractive motifs punctuated with some vibrant colors offer a real glimpse into the beauty of European designs. Our products are Designed in Europe and Made in India.

WARNING: Keep away from naked flame. Use this product with the utmost care when handling hot items in order to protect your hands. If you feel the item is too hot, touch the item cautiously with this product to assess the heat before handling it.
